intro.titulo: How to use the PMO family,
intro.texto: A real Claude Code session, sped up and in Spanish, on a test portfolio with synthetic material.

cierre.aviso: Real Claude Code recording, sped up. The portfolio is a test one: the material is synthetic.

capitulos.texto: Two commands in Claude Code: the Criterio catalogue and the PMO family. It installs Vera, Samuel and Alba, and Rostrum, the portal.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Vera, the portfolio. She processes the folder, finds the 6 projects and asks only what no document says: your role, your committee and how you want the report.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Claude Code asks for permission to open the agent's files, which are outside the folder. It is authorised once.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: The terms: each agent asks for its own yes, with the name of whoever accepts. Here, a demo user.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Vera's first sweep, over 3 of the 6 projects: PRY-005 reports green and does not hold up, and Nubetec invoiced 40 M more than what was accepted on PRY-003.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Samuel, the project manager. You choose which projects to set him up for; from the charter he takes the manager, the sponsor and the committee, and only asks to confirm them.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Alba, product, works before there is a project: she checks the business case against interviews with 8 merchants and the visit notes.

capitulos.titulo: The first result, in a table
capitulos.texto: What each agent found, with its figure: a green project that does not hold up, a report promised three times and 58 days overdue, and a target 28.0% above what was measured.

capitulos.titulo: The daily task, only with a yes
capitulos.texto: The family proposes a daily task that reviews only what is due. Here it was left to run by hand.

capitulos.titulo: Day to day, in your own words
capitulos.texto: Each agent is asked in natural language. Vera explains why PRY-005 does not hold up: an overdue deployment, a 31-day commitment and a milestone without its certificate.

capitulos.titulo: Day to day, in your own words
capitulos.texto: Samuel says which PRY-001 commitments are overdue, who holds them and what he does not know.
